title: Finish the #739 zero-execution scorer fix: restore it from commit 5db2610e, update pins and stale expectations, regenerate results
body:
## Goal
Finish the saved zero-execution fix of #739 (commit 5db2610e: score.py returns `unverified` when executed<=0, scored<=0 or native_run is null; regression cases; note benchmark/challenges/scorer-fix-0165.md). Two earlier finishes (#743, #747) stalled in the runner; #751 measured that import and generate() of both score.py versions finish promptly with a faulthandler-guarded exec probe (benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md, `## Cause`). Expected gain: the fix merged with consistent pins, fixture expectations and regenerated benchmark/results/challenges.json, recorded in benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md for the next shaper and the review. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no native behaviour.
Steps: (0) first turn run `python3 -I -c print(1)`; on a tool error write .session/report.md as blocked with the exact error and stop. (1) Run `git show --stat 5db2610e` and restore each file that commit changed with `git show 5db2610e:<path>` written through a helper script in .session/artifacts/ (do not rewrite by hand). (2) Find every pin of a changed file with Grep over benchmark/*.json (benchmark/preparation.json, benchmark/preparation-status.json) and update each hash in the same task. (3) Every helper that imports or runs score.py starts with faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(60, exit=True), reopens stdin on os.devnull and runs with `python3 -I`, as in .session/artifacts of #751 (method in scorer-stall-0168.md). Compare fixture `expected` values with generate() output; update stale expectations only where the difference is caused by the fix, and list each change. (4) Add a self-test case for native_run null if the commit lacks one. (5) Only then call main() once to rewrite benchmark/results/challenges.json. On a stall: record the faulthandler frames, do not rerun unchanged, report partial with saved files.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Files changed by 5db2610e are present on this branch with the commit's content (or a listed, justified difference).
- [ ] Every pin of a changed file in benchmark/*.json matches the file's new SHA256.
- [ ] benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md has sections headed exactly `## Restored`, `## Pins`, `## Expectations`, `## Checks`, listing files, old/new hashes, changed fixture expectations with reason, and each command run with its exit status.
- [ ] benchmark/results/challenges.json was regenerated by main() and parses as JSON; quality_measured stays false.
- [ ] No evaluator, network, model, reader or native call; no commit (the parent commits).
## Verification
python3 -I -c "import json; json.load(open('benchmark/results/challenges.json')); t=open('benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md').read().splitlines(); assert all(h in t for h in ('## Restored','## Pins','## Expectations','## Checks')); print('OK')"
## Context
- Reports of #739, #747, #751 are staged; check .session/exports/manifest.json first.
- benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md: the working probe method; avoid an importlib load-and-print helper.
- The local ref task/739 may not exist; use the commit id 5db2610e.
- benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py is invalidated (#544): never run it. Commands are argv strings without shell expansion; no long inline -c one-liners, write helper scripts with Write.
## Budget
- Reads: the three reports; scorer-stall-0168.md; `git show --stat 5db2610e`; Grep matches in benchmark/*.json; score.py only around changed lines (at most 80 lines). No whole fixture or results JSON; print short diffs.
- Restore by turn 8, pins by turn 14, expectations by turn 26, main() by turn 32, note and report by turn 40.

title: Review the merged zero-execution scorer finish (changed scope only)
body:
## Goal
Review, do not fix. Check that the finish of the #739 zero-execution fix is correct and consistent: score.py returns `unverified` for executed<=0, scored<=0 or native_run null; pins in benchmark/*.json match file hashes; each changed fixture expectation follows from the fix and nothing else; results regenerated. Expected gain: a CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict with numbered findings in .session/report.md that the next shaper reads to close or correct this scope. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] First turn: a tool probe (`python3 -I -c print(1)`); on failure report blocked with the exact error.
- [ ] The report pins the reviewed commit (`git rev-parse HEAD`) and SHA256 of score.py, benchmark/preparation.json and benchmark/results/challenges.json, computed by the reviewer.
- [ ] Each changed fixture expectation listed in benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md is checked against score.py logic, with a verdict per item.
- [ ] Verdict CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR with numbered findings in .session/report.md; detailed evidence in .session/artifacts/; no repository file written.
## Verification
python3 -I -c "t=open('benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md').read().splitlines(); assert '## Checks' in t; print('OK')"
## Context
- benchmark/challenges/scorer-finish-0169.md (the producer's note), benchmark/challenges/scorer-fix-0165.md, benchmark/challenges/scorer-stall-0168.md (probe method: faulthandler guard, stdin on devnull, python3 -I).
- Never call score.py main(); generate() only, through a guarded helper in .session/artifacts/. Never run benchmark/writing/check_c1_challenges_0125.py. No evaluator, network, model or native calls.
## Budget
- Reads: the three notes; `git diff` of score.py against its parent at most 200 lines; Grep of pins in benchmark/*.json; fixture entries named in the note only. No whole results JSON.
- Verdict draft by turn 20, report by turn 26.
